verdict.why: X and Y are close in coverage: both give one config per persona, keep the matrix at scenarios×personas, mark config-only findings with a control, keep schema design-review/1 additive, treat stand capture as read-only intake, and leave agent-tester untouched. X is pickable on buildability and internal consistency. (1) Correctness: X derives direction from locale, making dir-locale contradiction impossible by construction; Y states dir independently and must then invent contradiction rules (pseudo-rtl with ltr is refused, but 'ar' with ltr is accepted — an inconsistency the owner didn't ask for). (2) Verifiability: X ships 22 concrete gate tests tied to named exit codes and codes (CFG-*), plus a manifest contract (stand-captures/1) with SHA-256 checks, so the gate never calls the network; Y's stand contract is largely asserted against an unconfirmed door. (3) Decisions with reasons: both are strong, but X's decisions table is tighter and its open questions (Q1–Q10) all carry a default so the implementer is never blocked; Y leaves Q1 (dates, the owner-asked deliverable) pending. (4) Non-invention: Y introduces a panel-level exemptions line, a 'baseline persona' requirement, duplicate/stacked-axes warnings, and clean_in with yes/no/unverified — machinery the brief does not ask for; X's decline line for hard cells is leaner. (5) Conciseness: X's report row carries four axes vs Y's five (Y's dir is redundant with locale). X's weakness: the RTL-derivation table (T-22) embeds language knowledge in the gate, and REQ-3's six hard cells plus desktop is slightly beyond the brief's five configurations — but it covers exactly what the study names.
risks: X's phase-2 stand fetch depends on an unconfirmed door contract (X flags this as Q5/Q6 and defers the fetch step)
X's locale-derived direction puts a language list inside the gate; wrong or contested entries cause false rtl/ltr cell assignments
Y risks failing real panels via its baseline-persona and exemptions constraints, and its stand contract is unverifiable until the door is confirmed
